title: 翻译模拟测试
goal: 核对译句的原意和句子结构。

points.label: 选择完整保留原文信息的译句
排列主次清楚且结构正确的译句

sources.title: 大学英语四、六级考试内容和试卷结构
全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 六级翻译要求将一段 180—200 个汉字的中文译为英文，考试时间为 30 分钟。完整译文由汉译英练习中的模型整体批改。

items.stem: Choose the translation that preserves the meaning: 这条道路连接村庄和车站，但并不经过港口。
options: The road links the village and the station but does not pass through the port.
The road links the village and the port but does not pass through the station.
The road links the station and the port but does not pass through the village.
The road links the village to the station by passing through the port.
items.why: 原文说道路连接村庄和车站，不经过港口。第一项两点都保留了。

items.stem: Choose the translation that preserves the meaning: 部分居民参加了培训，培训由社区中心提供。
options: All residents attended training arranged by the community center.
Some residents attended training provided by the community center.
Some residents provided training that the community center attended.
The community center trained every resident who requested a course.
items.why: 原文是部分居民参加培训，培训由社区中心提供。第二项保留了 some 这个范围和提供者。第一项把部分改成了全部。

items.stem: Choose the translation that preserves the meaning: 这座桥于十年前建成，至今仍连接河流两岸。
options: The bridge will be completed in ten years and will connect both banks.
The bridge connected both banks only during its first ten years.
The bridge was completed ten years ago and still links both banks.
The bridge was started ten years ago and still does not link the banks.
items.why: 原文有两点：十年前建成，至今仍连接两岸。第三项用 was completed ten years ago 和 still links 保留了这两点。

items.stem: Choose the translation that preserves the meaning: 研究人员先测试设备，再向其他站点推广。
options: Researchers introduced the equipment at other sites before testing it.
Researchers tested equipment that other sites had already introduced.
Researchers tested the equipment only after other sites had adopted it.
Researchers tested the equipment before introducing it at other sites.
items.why: 原文的顺序是先测试、再推广。第四项用 tested ... before introducing 保留了这个顺序。

items.stem: Arrange the translation: 图书馆提供适合儿童的书籍。
items.why: provides 是谓语，that 从句修饰 books。

items.stem: Arrange the translation: 工作人员使用设备监测水位。
items.why: use 是谓语，to monitor 表示使用设备的目的。

items.stem: Arrange the translation: 这个项目帮助居民减少家庭废物。
items.why: helps residents reduce 构成帮助某人做某事的结构。

items.stem: Arrange the translation: 研究人员公布了去年收集的数据。
items.why: published 是谓语。that 从句修饰 data，说明数据是去年收集的。
